question: Techniques of making silk were first invented in China around _____ years ago.
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**7000**__.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The process of silk production is known as **sericulture.**
 
• It was **discovered by the Chinese 7000 **years ago.
 
• According to legend, the** princess Xi Lingshi discovered** that a cocoon could be unraveled to produce a thread when one dropped into her tea while sat under a mulberry tree.
 
• The secret of silk production is the tiny creature known as the silk worm, the most common being the **Bombyx Mori**.
 
• A flightless, domesticated moth, it lays 500 eggs in 5 days and then dies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Silk Route:**

 
 
• **​**The Silk Route was a network of **Eurasian trade routes active from the second century BCE until the mid-15th century.**
 
• Spanning over 6,400 kilometers.,
 
• It played a **central role in facilitating economic, cultural, political, and religious interactions** between the East and West.
 
• The name "Silk Road", first coined in the late 19th century, has fallen into disuse among some modern historians in favor of Silk Routes,
 
• It describes the intricate web of land and sea routes** connecting East and Southeast Asia**, **the Indian subcontinent, Central Asia, the Middle East, East Africa and Europe.**
